blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Issues Draft Interest Rate Directions 2026: Mandates Benchmark Linkage & Quarterly Reset Cap. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: RBI draft Interest Rate Directions 2026 mandate benchmark linkage for fixed/floating loans and cap floating reset frequency at 3 months.

📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
**Benchmark Linkage:** All loans must link to internal or external benchmark + risk-based spread; no loan below benchmark.
**Floating Reset Cap:** Floating rate benchmark reset frequency chosen by lender, capped at **max once every 3 months**.
**Agri Loans Reset:** Reset linked to crop season, capped at **max 12 months**.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**MCLR (marginal cost of funds-based lending rate) Rule:** Commercial banks, RRBs, Tier 3/4 UCBs with deposits >**₹1,000 crore** continue using MCLR (marginal cost of funds-based lending rate) internal benchmark.
**Mandatory External Benchmark:** Mandatory for floating personal and MSME loans by commercial banks.
≠ **Reset Cap:** Floating loan reset max once every 3 months; Agri loan reset max 12 months.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
